personality: 7 Dark-First Utility DARK with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: An aggressive, performance-focused interface built around deep obsidian, intense red accents, and large-format cinematic imagery that captures the raw energy of pro wrestling and underground podcasting.

spacing.rule: Dense horizontal spacing for stat tables, generous vertical breathing room around hero imagery and player controls. Use 16px padding on screen roots.

do's: Use heavy glass on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers to allow raw imagery to bleed underneath.
Use glass overlay on 'Featured Event' cards over dark stadium photography.
Add glassmorphism behind the Podcast Player controls when hovering over studio artwork.
dont's: Never blur dense stats tables or wrestler rosters.
Do not use glass for text-heavy news reading views.

screens.name: Accueil (Home)
screens.purpose: Immerse the fan immediately in the LGDP universe with big visuals, latest news, and a quick-play podcast snippet.

states.loading: Centered brand red spinner over deep obsidian.
states.empty: No content yet. 'L\'arène est vide. Revenez plus tard.'
states.error: Error loading feed. 'Erreur de connexion à l\'univers LGDP.'

screens.layout: Root scroll view. Top 40% is a cinematic Hero Banner (auto-playing or static dark stadium image) with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse). Below: Horizontal scroll of 'Événements à venir' (Upcoming Events) cards. Then: 'Dernier Podcast' (Latest Podcast) module with an inline play button and audio wave graphic. Finally: Vertical list of News cards.

screens.name: Lutte (Wrestling)
screens.purpose: A testosterone-fueled directory of wrestlers, ongoing rivalries, championships, and match results.
screens.layout: Sticky top segmented control (Roster | Matchs | Championnats). Roster: 2-column grid. Each card is a tall portrait image of an aggressive wrestler with a bottom-heavy gradient scrim, name in Barlow Condensed overlaid. Matchs: List view with high-contrast dates and VS layout. Championnats: Horizontal slider featuring championship belt images highlighting Gold accent.

screens.name: Podcast
screens.purpose: An immersive audio experience tailored for dark-mode, foreground and background listening.
screens.layout: Spotify-inspired layout. Top: Square podcast cover art (neon studio vibes) taking up 50% of the screen. Middle: Title, metadata, and huge pill-shaped Play/Pause button in brandPrimary red. Bottom: Progress bar, Favorites (heart), Share, and Up Next horizontal queue. Uses background playback via expo-av/track-player.

screens.name: Billets (Tickets)
screens.purpose: Drive conversions for LGDP LIVE events through a streamlined, urgent purchase flow.

states.empty: No upcoming events. 'Aucun événement à venir.'

screens.layout: Vertical list of thick, high-contrast cards. Each card displays Date (large bold typography), Venue, and a 'Acheter' (Buy) primary CTA pinned to the right. Square integration module slides up in a Bottom Sheet upon tapping 'Acheter'.

screens.name: Boutique (Store)
screens.purpose: Sell merchandise (shirts, caps, posters) with a premium streetwear / athletic aesthetic.
screens.layout: 2-column grid. Product images isolated on 'surfaceTertiary' or metallic carbon backgrounds. Price and Name aligned below the image. Tapping a product opens a full-screen modal with image carousel, size selector (segmented control), and a sticky 'Ajouter au panier' (Add to Cart) CTA at the bottom thumb zone.

screens.name: Profil
screens.purpose: Manage fan identity, saved podcasts, and purchased tickets.

states.empty: Not logged in state with prompt to Auth.

screens.layout: Header with User Avatar and Stats (e.g., 'Fan depuis 2024'). List sections for 'Mes Billets' (My Tickets) and 'Podcasts Favoris' (Favorite Podcasts). Auth uses JWT + Google.

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere STRICTLY to the Dark-First Utility DARK design personality with Glass / Luxe accents.
Do NOT use Inter or Roboto. You must use 'Barlow Condensed' for displays, headings, and aggressive numbers, and 'Manrope' for readable body text and metadata.
BANNED: Blue, purple, and indigo. Stick strictly to the defined deep obsidian and intense red/gold tokens.

IMPLEMENT A SCRIM (gradient overlay) on ALL text that sits over images. Use a 3-stop vertical gradient from transparent to surface (black) at >= 70% opacity at the bottom. This is non-negotiable for the Hero banner and Roster grid.
Use Phosphor icons. Stick to a single weight (e.g., bold or regular) across all screens. Use outlined for inactive tabs, filled for active tabs.
Ensure buttons are large and impactful (thumb-zone optimized). Primary CTAs should be pinned at the bottom on scrolling pages.
Include 'Square' payment processing module in the Tickets section and ensure a smooth bottom-sheet checkout flow.
Ensure 'Podcast' audio player supports background execution.
